high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a webpage or an online article discussing the Carlo Rovelli theory. The text provides information about Rovelli's work in quantum mechanics, specifically his relational interpretation introduced in 1994. Text Content: The main text explains that in 1994, Carlo Rovelli introduced the relational interpretation of quantum mechanics. It states that this interpretation is based on the idea that the quantum state of a system must always be interpreted relative to another physical system.
